career_ladder.note: Central Food Safety Officers (CFSOs) are the principal statutory enforcement cadre of the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Operating across regional offices, major ports, airports, and inland container depots, CFSOs inspect food business operators (FBOs), draw statutory samples, enforce food labeling standards, and manage import food clearance. Promotion through executive and director-level posts is governed by the FSSAI Recruitment and Promotion Regulations.

exam_scheme.note: The selection scheme for FSSAI Central Food Safety Officer (CFSO) comprises a two-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Document Verification. Stage 1 serves as an all-India screening examination (shortlisting in a 1:20 ratio), and Stage 2 evaluates advanced regulatory and domain technical knowledge.

stages.stage_name: CBT Stage 1: Computer Based Screening Test
stages.source_label: FSSAI — Scheme of Examination for CFSO (Advt DR-04/2021)

papers.paper_name: Part A: General Aptitude (General Intelligence 10 Qs, General Awareness 10 Qs, English 10 Qs, Computer Literacy 10 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: +4 marks for correct answer, -1 mark for each incorrect answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Screening examination for shortlisting to CBT Stage 2 in 1:20 ratio

papers.paper_name: Part B: Functional Knowledge (Indian & International Food Laws 20 Qs, FSSAI Structure & Initiatives 20 Qs, Subject Matter Knowledge - Food Chemistry/Microbiology/Processing 40 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: +4 marks for correct answer, -1 mark for each incorrect answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Combined aggregate score out of 480 across Part A and Part B determines shortlisting to Stage 2

stages.stage_name: CBT Stage 2: Computer Based Written Examination
stages.source_label: FSSAI — CBT Stage 2 Examination Syllabus & Marking Structure

papers.paper_name: Technical Examination (In-depth Food Safety & Standards Act, Codex Alimentarius, Food Testing, Contaminants, Additives, Food Hygiene)
papers.negative_marking: +4 marks for correct, -1 mark for wrong answer (80 questions)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Final merit drawn 100% on CBT Stage 2 marks followed by Document Verification

financial_package.pay_source_label: FSSAI Recruitment Notice DR-04/2021 — Pay Matrix Level 7 (₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated based on 7th CPC Level 7 entry basic pay of ₹44,900. Dearness Allowance at canonical 58% equals ₹26,042. House Rent Allowance ranges from ₹4,490 (10% in Z-class towns) to ₹13,470 (30% in X-class metros like Delhi/Mumbai/Kolkata/Chennai). Transport Allowance ranges from ₹2,844 to ₹5,688 (including 58% DA). Monthly deductions include National Pension System (10% of Basic + DA = ₹7,094), CGHS, and standard taxes.
official_perks: Central Government residential quarters or House Rent Allowance (up to 30% in metropolitan ports and regional headquarters)
Transport Allowance and official travel reimbursement for field inspection and port duties
Comprehensive medical coverage under Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual paid leave entitlements
Defined contribution benefits under National Pension System (NPS) with 14% employer contribution and Central Government Gratuity
Children Education Allowance (CEA) and annual hostel subsidy
